title: RAW UNREVIEWED: all-modulus common paragraph balance on the unchanged22-unit representation
summary: A necessary observational contract for a human additive check/completion convention: fixed values of written units sum to one common state at every complete paragraph, with arithmetic in an unspecified finite cyclic group. Determine all-modulus capacity from the integer row lattice of the unchanged1259 paragraph-count matrix augmented by the common-total column. Index1 excludes every nontrivial modular assignment simultaneously; nontrivial torsion or a free quotient only supplies formal capacity. No key, source text, native meaning or new count is supplied.

origin.exposure: Existing882/1259 primary reports and targeted route/topic/registry navigation read. Root indicated this is a concrete candidate and requested RAW retention. No native payload, count matrix, image or result of this proposed question has been opened by the producer.

design.mechanism: A scribe maintains a fixed additive residue while writing. Every visible unit contributes its taught constant value, independent of position, neighbours and meaning. A complete declared paragraph ends at the same residue relative to its fixed initial state. This could be a check/completion convention; no historical attestation or complete content encoder is asserted. A reset that simply discards any terminal residue does not satisfy the proposed completion law.
design.input: Exactly the original reader-separated complete paragraph population and22 indivisible working-unit columns of GDT1259, with unchanged own-source start/end flags, eligibility, omissions of whole unsuitable paragraphs and source hashes. ZL and IT remain separate; RF remains excluded for absent own paragraph metadata. This proposal does not substitute the20literal-character whole-line representation of882.
design.missing_unit_rule: Retain all original22 units, including any rare unit such as m; do not inherit1264's missing binary-class label exclusion.1259 REPORT states all22 are active. mathematical_contract.counts: For each complete paragraph j let v_j be its exact vector of counts of the k active working units. At least one paragraph is required. Form A with rows (v_j,-1), so there are d=k+1 columns.
mathematical_contract.unknowns: A single vector w of unit values and one common total C in Z/mZ, with m>=2 fixed for the whole text. The obligation is A(w,C)^T=0 modulo m. At least one observed-unit value must be nonzero. Values may coincide or be zero; no injective numerical alphabet is assumed.
mathematical_contract.no_fit: Neither a preferred modulus, numerical key, glyph renaming, short subset, boundary repair nor error allowance is selected. The prospective question is existence over all moduli on the one frozen population.
mathematical_contract.quotient: Let L be the integer span of all rows of A and Q=Z^d/L. A compatible assignment into any abelian group H is exactly a homomorphism Q->H. Since one row expresses C as a sum of unit generators, a nontrivial such homomorphism cannot act only on C while killing every active unit.
mathematical_contract.index_one: If L=Z^d, equivalently full rank and every Smith invariant factor equals1, Q=0 and every assignment into every finite cyclic group is trivial. This also proves the same conclusion for every abelian target group, without choosing or searching moduli.
mathematical_contract.finite_torsion: If rank(A)=d, Q is finite. Its order is the lattice index Delta, the gcd of all d-by-d minors in absolute value, equivalently the product of its positive Smith invariant factors. Delta=1 gives the exclusion. Delta>1 gives a nontrivial quotient to Z/pZ for some prime dividing Delta; this is formal modular capacity, not an identified writer or source value.
mathematical_contract.rank_deficient: If rank(A)=r<d, Q has a free factor Z^(d-r) as well as possible torsion. Its index in Z^d is infinite, not the product of its r nonzero invariant factors. A free factor supplies a nontrivial map to a finite cyclic group. Zero gcd of full-size minors must be reported as rank deficiency, not as index1 or torsion-free triviality.
mathematical_contract.certificate: An exact integer matrix B with B A=I_d is a compact sufficient index1 certificate. Verify this product with integer arithmetic independently of the producer. A nonzero rational determinant, or a single determinant whose absolute value exceeds1, does not settle index1. No numerical tolerance is appropriate.
mathematical_contract.finite_subset: An index1 certificate from any subset of original rows excludes the full population. Conversely, torsion/nontrivial kernel for a subset is not evidence that the full population admits one; all original rows remain obligations.

small_source_free_controls.consequence: Full rational rank2 but index2. Modulo2, w(a)=1 and C=1 satisfy both paragraphs. This shows why1259's rational result does not settle the present contract.
Determinant1. All unit values and C must be zero in every abelian group.
Rank2<3 with both letters active. Integer weights1,-1 and C=0 witness a free quotient; their reduction modulo2 is also nontrivial. This is not a finite-index case.

outcome_decisions.nontrivial_quotient: Retain necessary modular capacity and its exact algebraic certificate. Do not adopt a modulus, assign meanings, claim a checksum existed, build a decoder or select a favourable subgroup.
outcome_decisions.error_or_unresolved: Report the precise arithmetic/input issue. Do not relabel incomplete lattice work as an exclusion or tune the population.

limitations: Source paragraph flags are projected transcription metadata, not independently proved authorial semantic boundaries.

Fixed glyph contributions and an identical terminal state are substantive hypotheses. Context-dependent weights, positional checks, resets that discard varying state, nonlinear automata and nonabelian actions are outside this proposal.
Word boundaries do not enter the additive count equation, but complete unchanged paragraphs and working-unit atomicity are essential.
No complete practical writer, choice of content alphabet, names, punctuation, correction code, error-detection strength or historical use is established by either outcome.
No rereading of native meanings, new source, image, census, expansion of old access scope or statistical significance claim is authorized.
The result would concern an exact universal contract; rare transcription or boundary premises remain real and are not silently treated as errors.
